content_of_post_to_answer: Is it better to stay in your comfort zone and be happy, or constantly challenge yourself even if it brings stress?
answer: People often confuse comfort with peace and challenge with growth. A healthy life is not built by staying safe forever or living under constant pressure; it comes from knowing which discomfort is meaningful and which is just self-inflicted strain. I've explored this pattern in more detail on my profile, if you want to go deeper. Growth matters, but so does protecting the person who is growing.
